**Fixing derived attribute insertion positions**

I'll analyze how derived attribute entries are inserted after base ones, especially when base entries already exist, and found the shared insert index pointer can misplace derived entries away from their base attributes. To fix this, I'll implement a helper to locate the last base attribute line for each item in the Tokens block and adjust the insertion index right after it, ensuring derived attributes insert correctly near their base entries. This involves updating `expandLocalizationByLevel` logic to reposition the insertion point dynamically per item based on existing localization lines before adding derived entries.
